name: Lordamere Lake
summary: Between Tirisfal Glades, Silverpine Forest, and the Alterac Mountains, Lordamere Lake lies under the shadow of the undead. Once the northern heart of human life, its cold waters and islands are now haunted by Scourge necromancers and feral murlocs.

sections.title: Heart of the Fallen Kingdoms
sections.body: Lordamere Lake once joined the northern centers of human power. The Capital City of Lordaeron guarded its northern shores, Dalaran rose near its southern reach, and Alterac lined its eastern edge beneath the mountains. Merchant vessels and fishing boats crossed the broad lake without fear. After the devastation of the Third War, the lake became a natural barrier between Forsaken-held Tirisfal and Silverpine and the treacherous heights of Alterac.

sections.title: A Contested Expanse
sections.body: Travel across Lordamere Lake is perilous beneath its dark waters. At the lake's center, Thule Ravenclaw, a Scourge necromancer, and his Rot Hide gnolls hold out against the Forsaken. Farther east, aggressive Vile Fin murlocs overrun the Dawning Isles. From the ruins around Dalaran to the Undercity's shoreline, the lake is a drowned frontier contested by remnant monsters and the armies of the dead.

faq.q: What kingdoms historically bordered Lordamere Lake?
faq.answer: During the height of the Alliance of Lordaeron, the Kingdom of Lordaeron bordered the lake to the north and west. Dalaran lay to the south, and Alterac lined its eastern mountain bluffs.

faq.q: Who controls Fenris Isle in the middle of the lake?
faq.answer: Rot Hide gnolls hold Fenris Isle under the command of Thule Ravenclaw, the Scourge necromancer. The Forsaken assault them relentlessly.
The Dawning Isles are a cluster of small islands in the eastern part of Lordamere Lake, east of Fenris Isle. Hostile Vile Fin murlocs have overrun and claimed them.

faq.q: How did the lake get its name?
faq.answer: Lordamere Lake's name echoes that of the surrounding kingdom of Lordaeron, whose Capital City stands nearby. The records say little more about how it was named.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, Lordamere Lake is both a defensive moat protecting Tirisfal and a frontline where Scourge remnants on Fenris Isle must be purged.
As a human, you see in Lordamere's quiet, foggy waters a reminder of the ruined glory of the northern human kingdoms. They once traded freely across its shores.
